claims.text: Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience, but only after Contract Year 2.

citations.quote: Each Party may also terminate the Agreement for convenience after Contract Year 2

claims.text: Termination for convenience requires written notice to the other party at least sixty (60) calendar days before the effective date of termination.

citations.quote: by providing written notice to the other Party at least sixty (60) calendar days prior to the effective date of such termination

claims.text: Contract Year 2 runs from February 1, 2020 through January 31, 2021.
